h1: The 6 Best Metal Bed Frames of 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaTitle: Best Metal Bed Frames 2026: Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: six queen metal bed frames, from a foldable platform to 2,500 lb and Victorian designs, with capacity, clearance and tradeoffs.
summary: The Amazon Basics Foldable Platform is the easiest frame to own, with tool-free setup and a 700 lb rating. The DIIYIV frame has the highest listed capacity at 2,500 lb, Hafenpo and NEW JETO offer 1,100 lb for less, and SHA CERLIN and Yaheetech are the Victorian options.
intro: A metal frame earns its keep in the joints. Welds and bolted connections decide whether it squeaks within a month, and a weight rating means little if the legs flex at the joints.
We reviewed queen metal frames on listed capacity, steel type, leg count, clearance and noise features. Six made the cut, ranked by how well they combine strength, setup and price.

products.name: Amazon Basics Foldable Metal Platform Bed Frame Queen
products.verdict: A tool-free folding frame with 13 inches of clearance and a 700 lb rating.
products.description:
This alloy steel queen platform is 14 inches tall, folds flat with tool-free setup, offers 13 inches of underbed clearance and lists a 700 lb capacity and a 1-year warranty. It costs $100-200.

It takes first place on ease of ownership: it folds for moves and needs no tools. Against the 1,100 lb frames, it rates lower but is simpler.

It suits renters and movers. The 1-year warranty is short.

products.name: DIIYIV Queen High Headboard Vintage Gate Metal Bed Frame
products.verdict: A 2,500 lb rated frame with a tall vintage-gate headboard.
products.description:
The DIIYIV is a 14 inch alloy steel queen frame with nine legs, a tall vintage-gate headboard and a 2,500 lb capacity, with 12.7 inches of clearance. It costs $50-100.

It ranks second because the stated capacity is the highest here and the price is moderate. Against Hafenpo, it adds a headboard.

It suits buyers wanting a statement headboard.

products.name: Hafenpo Queen 14 Inch Metal Bed Frame with Reinforced Legs
products.verdict: A plain powder-coated steel frame rated for 1,100 lb.
products.description:
The Hafenpo is a 14 inch powder-coated steel queen frame with reinforced anti-twist legs, a 1,100 lb rating, 12.1 inches of clearance and a noise-reducing tube design. It costs $50-100.

It ranks third because it lacks a headboard but delivers strength and quiet at a modest price. Against NEW JETO, it adds anti-twist legs.

It suits a plain, sturdy base.

products.name: NEW JETO Queen 14 Inch Wrought Iron Bed Frame
products.verdict: Wrought iron with squeak-free foot plugs and a 1,100 lb rating.
products.description:
The NEW JETO is a 14 inch powder-coated wrought iron frame with nine legs, 12 inches of clearance, a 1,100 lb rating and plastic foot plugs. It costs $50-100.

It ranks fourth because it matches Hafenpo's rating without its anti-twist detail. Against it, the foot plugs protect floors.

It suits hardwood floors.

products.name: SHA CERLIN Queen Victorian Wrought Iron Bed Frame
products.verdict: A Victorian iron frame with silent pads on every bar.
products.description:
The SHA CERLIN is a 12.4 inch thick metal tube Victorian frame with silent pads on every metal bar, a 800 lb rating and under 30 minute assembly. It costs $100-200.

It ranks fifth because strength is lower than plain frames. Against Yaheetech, it is pricier but quieter by design.

It suits light sleepers.

products.name: Yaheetech Victorian Vintage Queen Metal Platform Bed Frame
products.verdict: An iron-art Victorian frame with 12 metal slats at $50-100.
products.description:
The Yaheetech is a 14 inch queen platform in a Victorian iron-art style with matching head and foot ends, using 12 metal slats and giving 12.6 inches of room underneath, rated for 600 lb. It costs $50-100.

It ranks last because 600 lb is the lowest rating here. Against SHA CERLIN, it saves money.

It suits traditional bedrooms on a budget.

whatMatters.detail: A weight rating shows the total load. Compare with mattress plus sleepers. Check the pounds in the listing.
More legs spread load. Nine legs with a center bar are common. Check leg count.
Pads and plugs prevent squeaks at joints. Check for them.
Some frames need a box spring. Check before buying.

faq.q: Do these need a box spring?
faq.a: Platform frames do not. The 9-leg Amazon Basics needs one.

finalTake: The Amazon Basics Foldable is the safest buy for most people. Pick Hafenpo for strength at a modest price, DIIYIV for a headboard and top capacity, and SHA CERLIN for quiet Victorian style.
